method: Yellow Pages QLD 'Trailers & Trailer Parts' listings for 16 regions (211 listings), filtered to sellers of new light trailers, then each business's own website read for contact details and sourcing. Facts below are as published on the cited pages; 'inference' marks our interpretation.

prospects.sells: Hot-dip galvanised box and cage trailers (8x5 tipping with 600/900mm cage), ATV trailers with rear ramp, premium box trailers.
evidence: Website: "Smart global sourcing meets meticulous Australian assembly"
Website: "Every Wide Bay trailer features heavy-duty galvanised steel"
Listed: 8X5 Tipping Hot Dipped Galvanised Box Trailer 750kg ATM 600mm Cage, $3,000
prospects.sourcing: Imports and assembles locally (stated on their website).
prospects.cater: They already buy overseas and assemble in QLD, so we slot straight into their process: same flat-pack model, better-documented steel, factory-direct price and pay-as-you-sell terms. Match their tipping cage and ATV best sellers first.
prospects.angle: Switch supplier: same assembly workflow, better steel with mill certs, credit terms their current supplier won't give.
prospects.opener: I noticed Wide Bay Trailers sources globally and assembles here in Queensland. That's exactly how we supply dealers, so I thought it was worth a conversation.
prospects.range_line: 8x5 tipping cage trailers, ATV trailers and tandems

prospects.region: Brisbane / Sunshine Coast (also Newcastle and Perth)
prospects.address: 7071 Bruce Highway, Chevallum QLD 4555 (Sunshine Coast branch); Brisbane, Newcastle (HQ) and Perth branches
prospects.email_note: No public email address. Use the quote/contact form on the website or call.
prospects.sells: Over 50 models of hot-dip galvanised trailers: box, tradie, plant, tipper, car carrier, boat, livestock, motorbike, mower/ATV and off-road.
evidence: Website: "The home of Australia's favourite galvanised trailers"
Website: "low cost and high-quality galvanised trailers with over 50 models to choose from"
Branches in Brisbane, Sunshine Coast, Newcastle and Perth
prospects.sourcing: Not stated. Inference: low-cost galvanised range of 50+ models across four states is typical of an importer. Confirm on the call.
prospects.cater: Highest-volume prospect on the list. Four branches across QLD, NSW and WA means multi-container orders, and it gets us into NSW and WA through one customer. Offer a mixed container that matches their 10 best sellers and a dedicated QLD trial before rolling out to other branches.
prospects.angle: Second source for a high-volume galvanised range, with certified steel and pay-as-you-sell.
prospects.opener: Bonanza has built a big following for galvanised trailers across four states. I'd like to show you how we could supply part of that range direct from our own factory.
prospects.range_line: box, tradie, plant, tipper and car trailers
prospects.meeting: at your Brisbane or Sunshine Coast branch

prospects.priority: High (check first: may already be a customer)
prospects.address: HQ: 947 Beaudesert Rd, Archerfield QLD 4108 (from 20 Apr 2026). Stores: Brendale, Molendinar (Gold Coast), Harristown (Toowoomba), Campbellfield VIC
prospects.email_note: Branch emails also published: northbrisbane@, gc@, toowoomba@, sales.vic@stonegateindustries.com.au
prospects.sells: Own-brand trailers (box, cage, tandem, tradesman/builders, enclosed, gardening, boat/jetski, farm, hydraulic tippers, UTV), plus toolboxes, ute trays, canopies and off-road motorbikes.
evidence: Website: "Australia's best-selling trailer brand, 10 years strong"
Prices listed: 6x4 box $1,399; 8x5 tandem box $3,299; 8x6 premium galvanised box $2,099; 12x6 tandem 600mm cage 3500kg $7,799
Runs a "Become a Reseller" program and five stores across QLD and VIC
prospects.sourcing: Not stated. Inference: very sharp retail pricing and a broad multi-category range suggest offshore manufacturing. Confirm on the call.
prospects.cater: A brand owner with five stores and its own reseller network. Pitch Innovatix as a build partner: we manufacture to their spec under the Stonegate brand, with certified steel they can market. Big volume potential.
prospects.angle: Private-label manufacturing partner: their brand, our factory, certified steel and pay-as-you-sell.
prospects.opener: Stonegate has built one of the best-known trailer brands in Queensland. I'd like to talk about building part of your range in our own factory, under your brand.
prospects.range_line: box, cage, tandem and tradesman trailers and ute trays

prospects.sells: Galvanised box and cage trailers (single and tandem), tradesman, car carriers (semi flat top, box, beaver tail), hydraulic tippers, van trailers, gardening and mower trailers, flat tops, stock crates, jetski trailers, toolboxes. Sizes 6x4 to 16x6'6.
evidence: Website lists a separate "Australian Galvanised Trailers" category (16 models) alongside larger galvanised box and cage categories
Website: "2% Price Beat", "12 month structural warranty", 4.7 stars from 218 Google reviews
Website: "40+ Years Manufacturing Trailers"
prospects.sourcing: Mixed. Inference: the separate 'Australian Galvanised' category implies most of the rest of the range is not Australian-made. Confirm on the call.
prospects.cater: Large, price-led range with a price-beat promise, so landed cost matters most to them. Target the non-Australian part of their range: galvanised box/cage, car carriers and tippers, in a mixed container.
prospects.angle: Lower landed cost to protect their price-beat margin, with better steel than typical imports.
prospects.opener: Trailers Down Under carries one of the widest ranges in South-East Queensland. I'd like to show you how we could supply part of it at a better landed cost.
prospects.range_line: galvanised box and cage trailers, car carriers and tippers

prospects.sells: Galvanised box (standard and heavy duty), tandem galvanised box up to 3500kg ATM, buggy trailers, plant trailers, flat decks, hydraulic flat-deck and box tippers, custom builds. Up to 4.5T ATM.
evidence: Website: "quality built Australian made, Custom built and Imported trailers upto 4.5T ATM"
Website: "a locally owned and operated family business", staff "trade qualified with over 20 years experience"
prospects.sourcing: Sells imported trailers alongside Australian-made and custom (stated on their website).
prospects.cater: Already sells an imported line. Offer to supply that line with certified steel and better terms, and support their heavier galvanised range (plant, tippers, 3500kg tandems), which suits farm buyers on the Downs.
prospects.angle: Better imported line: certified steel, fully galvanised, pay-as-you-sell.
prospects.opener: I saw Toowoomba Trailers carries an imported range alongside your Australian-made and custom builds. I'd like to show you a better-documented option for that imported line.
prospects.range_line: galvanised box, plant and tipper trailers

prospects.email_note: No public email address. Use the website contact form or call.
prospects.sells: Trailer sales, hire, parts and service. Sales stock: galvanised box trailers with cages (6x4 to 8x6 1400kg), ATV trailers with ramps, car trailers, flat tops, hydraulic tippers, cattle floats, cold-room trailers. Hire fleet of car, cage, flat top, tipper, enclosed and cattle trailers.
evidence: Website listing: "7 x 4 ft Premium Galvanized Box Trailer ATM: 750kg"
Website listing: "Hot Dipped Galvanized Fully Welded (Rust Free)" ATV trailers
Website: trailer rentals "for over 5 years"
prospects.sourcing: Not stated. Inference: listing style ('Premium Galvanized', spec-sheet format) is typical of imported stock. Confirm on the call.
prospects.cater: Two ways to buy: retail stock and hire-fleet replacement. Hire trailers take a beating, so certified welds and heavy galvanising lower their repair costs. Pitch a mixed container for sales stock plus fleet units.
prospects.angle: Tougher trailers for retail and the hire fleet, with pay-as-you-sell on retail stock.
prospects.opener: I saw Dalby Trailers both sells and hires galvanised trailers across the Western Downs. I'd like to show you a range built for both jobs.
prospects.range_line: galvanised cage, ATV and tipper trailers
prospects.meeting: in Dalby, or by video call if easier

prospects.address: 62 Harper Street, Molendinar QLD 4214; Sunshine Coast branch at 191 Brisbane Road
prospects.email_note: No public email address. Use the website contact form or call.
prospects.sells: Box, tradesman, car, garden and lawn-mowing trailers, horse floats; trade-ins, servicing and spare parts.
evidence: Website: has "helped Aussies move, work, and explore for over 20 years" across the Sunshine Coast, Gold Coast and Brisbane
Two branches: Gold Coast (Molendinar) and Sunshine Coast
prospects.cater: An established two-branch retailer. Lead with a value range that adds margin next to whatever they stock now, and a trial container split across both branches.
prospects.angle: Second supplier: better margin on core box and tradesman models, no stock risk.
prospects.opener: Trailers Direct has been selling trailers on the Gold Coast and Sunshine Coast for over 20 years. I'd like to show you a range that could add margin across both branches.

prospects.email_note: No public email address on the site. Call, or use the contact page.
prospects.sells: Own Australian-made trailers plus brands KJM (box trailers), VRM custom off-road, and Mackay, Dunbier and Redco boat trailers. Sizes 6x4 to 12x7; drop side, flat bed, hydraulic tippers.
evidence: Website: "THE LARGEST RANGE OF TRAILERS IN FNQ", "Trusted for over 40 Years"
Website: "KJM Box Trailers - Affordable High Quality" sold next to "Taylors Trailers - Quality Australian Made Here in Cairns"
prospects.sourcing: Mixed: builds its own and resells other brands, including an 'affordable' box-trailer line.
prospects.cater: Don't pitch against their Australian-made line. Offer to supply the 'affordable' tier (currently KJM) and galvanised boat trailers for the coastal market, where salt makes galvanising matter.
prospects.angle: Affordable line partner: certified, fully galvanised value range alongside their own builds.
prospects.opener: Taylors Trailers carries both your own Cairns-built trailers and an affordable box-trailer range. I'd like to show you an option for that value tier.
prospects.range_line: value box trailers and galvanised boat trailers
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person on our next far north trip

prospects.email_note: No public email address found. Call, or use the website contact page.
prospects.sells: Standard box trailers, tandems, custom builds, horse floats; on-the-spot registration.
evidence: Directory: "provides the largest range of standard size box trailers and custom-built trailers at competitive prices"
Yellow Pages also lists Hans Trailers (a stockist listing) at the same address, so they resell brands they don't build
prospects.sourcing: Resells at least one outside brand; own sourcing not stated.
prospects.cater: Standard sizes in volume are their core business. Mining-region buyers want heavy-duty and galvanised, so lead with tandem and heavy-duty box trailers.
prospects.angle: Heavy-duty standard sizes at a better margin, with pay-as-you-sell.
prospects.opener: Mackay Trailers carries one of the biggest ranges of standard box trailers in the region. I'd like to show you a heavy-duty galvanised range at a better margin.
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person on our next north Queensland trip

prospects.email_note: No public email address. Call or use the website.
prospects.sells: Trailer sales and hire, camper trailers, accessories.
evidence: Website: "Quality, affordable trailers in Far North Queensland!"
Website: "Our trailers exceed registration requirements in all states and the applicable Australian Design Rules"
prospects.cater: Sales and hire in a humid, coastal climate. Full hot-dip galvanising and certified welds are the hook. Offer sales stock and hire-fleet units in one container.
prospects.angle: Affordable but tougher: galvanised for the tropics, pay-as-you-sell.
prospects.opener: FNQ Trailers sells and hires affordable trailers across the far north. I'd like to show you a fully galvanised range built for tropical conditions.
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person on our next far north trip

prospects.email_note: No public email address found. Call, or use the website.
prospects.sells: Trailers and trailer accessories (detail not published on the pages we could read).
evidence: Yellow Pages: Trailers & Trailer Parts, Garbutt (Townsville)
prospects.cater: Little public detail. Qualify on the phone first (volumes, top models, current source), then send the range proposal.
prospects.angle: Second supplier with better margin and no stock risk.
prospects.opener: I'm reaching out to a few trailer dealers in Townsville about a new range that's landing well with Queensland dealers.
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person on our next north Queensland trip

prospects.sells: Off-road, galvanised and tandem trailers; trailer service and repairs.
evidence: Website: "supplying robust and reliable trailers to customers in the local area for more than 16 years"
Website: "Fabricated and hot-dipped in galvanised steel"
prospects.sourcing: Appears to fabricate locally; not fully stated.
prospects.cater: Likely builds some of its own. Offer standard sizes so their workshop can focus on off-road and custom work, which earns more.
prospects.angle: Capacity partner: we supply the standard sizes, they keep the custom work.
prospects.opener: Budget Trailers has supplied Townsville for over 16 years. I'd like to show you how we could take the standard sizes off your workshop so you can focus on the custom work.
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person on our next north Queensland trip

prospects.sells: Trailer parts retailer (axles, couplings, brakes, jockey wheels, tyres, toolboxes, hydraulic tipper kits) and trailers.
evidence: Website: team with "more than 30 years in the industry"
Website sells Hydraulic Tipper Kits & Parts; ABN 68 656 048 997, Yeomans Industries Pty Ltd T/A The Trailer Shop
prospects.cater: They have the parts and assembly know-how, which suits flat-pack. Offer kits and rolling chassis as well as complete trailers, plus galvanised tipper bodies to pair with the hydraulic kits they already sell.
prospects.angle: Flat-pack kits and chassis that use the parts and skills they already have.
prospects.opener: The Trailer Shop already supplies the parts and tipper kits Bundaberg builders rely on. I'd like to show you our flat-pack trailers and chassis, which fit naturally with that.
prospects.range_line: flat-pack box trailers, chassis and tipper bodies

prospects.address: Unit 1, 82 Enterprise Street, Kunda Park QLD 4556
prospects.email_note: Website (sunnytrailers.com.au) was not loading on 24 Nov 2026 and no email is published. Call.
prospects.sells: Standard box trailers through to hot-dip galvanised custom builds; trailer registration.
evidence: Directory: "from standard box trailers to hot dipped galvanised custom-built trailers", authorised to register trailers
prospects.cater: Mostly custom and local. Offer standard sizes so they can sell entry-level trailers cheaply and keep the custom work.
prospects.angle: Entry-level range to win price-sensitive buyers without tying up their workshop.
prospects.opener: I'm reaching out to a few trailer businesses on the Sunshine Coast about a galvanised standard range that could sit alongside your custom builds.
prospects.meeting: in person on the Sunshine Coast

prospects.sells: Box trailers (on-road and off-road), heavy-duty tandems, car trailers 12-16ft, enclosed trailers, lawn-mowing trailers.
evidence: Website: "high-quality, Australian made trailers Brisbane, Sunshine Coast and Gold Coast wide at factory direct prices"
prospects.cater: Don't lead with China or quality. Offer a partnership: rolling chassis or a private-label entry-level line so they can compete with cheap imports without discounting their Australian-made trailers.
prospects.angle: Capacity and component partner, never a replacement for their Aussie-made line.
prospects.opener: Austrailers builds Australian-made trailers at factory-direct prices. I wanted to ask whether extra fabrication capacity or a price-fighter line would be useful as import competition heats up.
prospects.range_line: galvanised chassis and entry-level box trailers

prospects.address: 24 Brisbane Road, Labrador QLD 4215; 17 Gladstone Road, Allenstown (Rockhampton) QLD 4700
prospects.contact_name: Daniel (email published on the Rockhampton contact block)
prospects.sells: Galvanised, car, custom, machinery and tipper trailers.
evidence: Website: "we're 100% ... Australian made", "uses only high-quality Australian made materials", family-owned, "over a decade"
prospects.cater: Their brand rests on Australian materials, so an import pitch will fail. Only approach about overflow fabrication or a separately branded value range for their Rockhampton branch. Low probability.
prospects.angle: Overflow capacity or a separately branded value line.
prospects.opener: I'm reaching out to a few Queensland trailer manufacturers to ask whether extra fabrication capacity would help in busy periods.

prospects.email_note: No public email address. Use the contact form on hansgroup.com.au or call.
prospects.sells: Box, tandem, builders, car, plant, custom trailers, stock crates and Beef Boss livestock equipment; stockists across QLD (about 30 Yellow Pages stockist listings).
evidence: Website: "100% Australian Made", "60 years in business", "5 Year Warranty"
Website offers "Contract Manufacturing"
prospects.sourcing: Australian manufacturer with a large stockist network.
prospects.cater: A big manufacturer with a statewide stockist network and an Australian Made brand. Not a buyer of finished imported trailers. The only angle is galvanised components or sub-assemblies to add capacity. Low probability, high volume if it lands.
prospects.angle: Component and sub-assembly supply (chassis, drawbars, cages) to add capacity.
prospects.opener: Hans has built trailers in Queensland for 60 years. I'm reaching out to ask whether galvanised components or sub-assemblies from our steel fabrication plant could help with capacity.

prospects.sells: Australian-made and custom-built trailers; trailer, caravan and horse float repairs and servicing; nationwide delivery.
evidence: Website: "Proudly Australian Made", "Trusted Since 1972"
prospects.cater: Established Australian builder. Pitch overflow capacity or chassis supply only.
prospects.angle: Capacity partner for standard sizes and chassis.
prospects.opener: Sunshine Coast Trailers has built trailers since 1972. I wanted to ask whether extra fabrication capacity for standard sizes would be useful.
prospects.range_line: galvanised chassis and standard box trailers

prospects.sells: Custom, box, builders, car, enclosed, galvanised, lawn mower, machinery, motorbike, table-top and tandem box trailers.
evidence: Website: "a locally owned and operated family business that designs and manufactures trailers"
prospects.cater: Small custom builder. Offer rolling chassis or standard sizes so they can quote faster and take on more jobs.
prospects.angle: Chassis and standard-size supply to grow output without hiring.
prospects.opener: Topline designs and builds custom trailers in Logan. I wanted to ask whether galvanised chassis or standard sizes from our factory could help you take on more work.
